entries.title: Task numbers in a card are links to their task
entries.body: When a card mentions one of your tasks by its number, like FI3-572, the number is now a link. Resting on it shows the same task summary as the Tasks panel, beside the card, and clicking it opens the task the way clicking its row in Tasks does: its waiting decision comes forward, or its record opens. A number that matches none of your tasks stays plain text.
entries.noPicture: Recorded before notes kept pictures; a release review takes one if this becomes a highlight.
